name: State Machine: Composite Logic
modt_content:
system
    name CompositeState

obj CoffeeMachine
    attr Working: bool [initial(true), state]
    attr HasWater: bool [initial(true), state]

    method RefillWater() [set(HasWater, true, Refill, false)]
    method MakeCoffee() [set(Working, true, Brew, true)]
        pre HasWater
    method Break() [set(Working, false, Error)]
